reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Dropped API versions: Kyverno 1.13 drops deprecated API versions for its managed CustomResourceDefinitions", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Existing resources at the dropped kyverno.io/v2alpha1 API versions (CleanupPolicy, ClusterCleanupPolicy, PolicyException) must be migrated: the Helm chart performs this migration automatically through its hook, but installations upgraded without Helm (or without the hook) must migrate existing resources themselves, e.g. via kube-storage-version-migrator.
consequence.remediation: Upgrade through the Helm chart so its migration hook runs automatically, or run kube-storage-version-migrator to migrate existing resources when upgrading without Helm (or without the hook).

proposed.statement: Kyverno 1.13 drops the deprecated kyverno.io/v2alpha1 API versions of the CleanupPolicy, ClusterCleanupPolicy and PolicyException CRDs, and existing resources at the dropped versions must be migrated — automatically by the Helm chart's migration hook, or via kube-storage-version-migrator when upgrading without Helm (or without the hook).
